    assert 'docx内部错误' in r.error_message
    assert r.file_bytes == b''
    assert r.local_path is None
    print\(f'错误处理: OK  -> {r.error_message}'\)

# 模拟磁盘写入权限错误

    assert '写入失败' in r2.error_message or '文件系统' in r2.error_message
    print\(f'权限错误处理: OK  -> {r2.error_message}'\)
